name: @oleksandr_krupko/mac-os-debloat
description: Debloat your Mac from the terminal: disable 296 non-essential macOS launchd services (Siri, Apple Intelligence, telemetry, ads, unused Apple apps) plus Spotlight, and keep them off across reboots. Works with SIP on; turn SIP off from the menu to disable every label. One-key presets, fully reversible, zero deps. macOS Tahoe 26 and Golden Gate 27, Apple Silicon.
author: Oleksandr Krupko
